# ADAM v0.50 Full Engineering and Qualification Report

## Executive result

ADAM v0.50 completes the requested bounded-development lineage from the verified v0.42 living-recreation universe through atomic physics, neural-symbolic cognition, application organs, predictive world modeling, embodiment, governed self-evolution and sovereign inference-safe distributed authority.

The result is not a conventional database with AI attached. The authoritative state consists of content-addressed identities, first-class bonds, hyperbonds, compounds, reactions, proofs, worldlines, chemistry versions, authority certificates and exact reconstruction evidence. Applications, documents, media, APIs, device views and model activations are constructed or activated from that state when demanded.

## v0.44 — Atomic Physics, Bond Algebra and Reaction Kernel

### First-class bond algebra

The previous subject–predicate–object form is extended into an immutable, deterministic bond object carrying family, direction, order, temporal validity, observation time, causal parents, authority, provenance, confidence, security scope, chemistry version, reaction origin and evidence references.

A bond is an atomic node. It can participate in another bond, allowing ADAM to express claims about relationships without flattening them into ungoverned metadata.

The standard chemistry includes **48 predicates across nine bond families**. Hyperbonds represent assignments, approvals and other multi-participant events as one role-complete structure.

### Reaction-only mutation

The official mutation surface is the deterministic reaction VM. A reaction:

1. binds typed participants;
2. checks required and forbidden structures;
3. applies valence and constitutional laws;
4. checks exact prior-root concurrency;
5. verifies authority and evidence;
6. simulates the candidate state;
7. emits a proof;
8. commits new and terminated bonds;
9. advances affected worldlines;
10. produces a new universe root.

The audit executed 40 alternating assignment/release reactions, creating 40 proofs, 40 hyperbonds and 40 worldline states. A multi-reaction root-definition defect was discovered by final integration testing, corrected, and protected by a regression test.

### Authority isolation and Rust path

A separate authority-service process is supplied for the executable reference branch. A Rust authority project is included with canonical types, framed log, replay, reaction validation, proof construction and conformance vectors. Rust was not compiled in this environment because no Rust toolchain was installed; no compiled-Rust claim is made.

## v0.45 — Neural-Symbolic Cognitive Chemistry

ADAM now trains over bonded structures rather than only tokens.

Implemented organs include:

- masked atom reconstruction;
- masked bond reconstruction;
- deterministic TransE-style graph embeddings;
- recurring compound discovery;
- causal-evidence classification;
- confidence calibration and OOD abstention;
- proof-guided proposal scoring.

Models, datasets, parameter compounds, evaluation metrics, capabilities and training runs can be proposed as universe structures. Model-worldline relations preserve what trained the model, which parameters were active, what metric supported promotion and what capability was authorized.

Concept atoms combine evidence into higher-order explainable structures such as project risk. A concept remains recursively expandable into supporting bonds, model identity and confidence.

## v0.46 — Universal Application Nervous System

Applications are treated as organs that observe, propose reactions and request constructions. Each application declares identity namespace, recognized entity types, field mappings, capabilities, authority scope and constructible forms.

The nervous system supports:

- application manifests;
- identity federation;
- exact event preservation;
- deterministic entity mapping;
- reaction proposal and commit paths;
- JSON and document adapters;
- temporary constructions.

Applications do not gain direct mutation authority. Proprietary integration still requires a manifest, adapter or event mapping; universal protocol support is not the same as automatic compatibility with every private product.

## v0.47 — Predictive World Universe

A temporal dynamics organ learns bounded state transitions and abstains outside its trained support. Shadow universes compare proposed reactions and possible futures without modifying accepted state.

Atomic goals specify desired state, authorized requester, required laws, deadline and priority. The planner may produce candidate reaction sequences, but a goal possesses no commit capability.

The incremental dependency engine tracks which derived structures depend on which atoms, bonds, laws and models. A changed dependency invalidates and recomputes only affected structures.

## v0.48 — Embodied Universe

Devices expose governed capability surfaces instead of giving cognition unrestricted hardware control. A surface declares sensors, actuators, units, latency, safety limits, confirmation requirements, compute/power constraints, communication paths and authority scope.

The embodiment layer includes:

- sensor observations linked to evidence;
- spatial and device-state atoms;
- digital twins;
- command envelopes;
- policy validation;
- human-confirmation gates;
- emergency stop and reset;
- offline edge queues and reconvergence.

The package validates and audits command envelopes. It does not claim direct operation of physical machinery in this environment.

## v0.49 — Governed Self-Evolving Chemistry

Discovery organs may propose better compounds, atom boundaries, reaction templates or representation strategies. Promotion requires historical replay, exact reconstruction, query equivalence, security equivalence, authority equivalence, economic comparison and independent approval.

The proposer cannot approve its own candidate. Accepted chemistry versions are immutable, worldline-addressed and rollback-capable.

The adaptive economy chooses among deep atomization, recursive factoring, opaque exact representation, temporary materialization, replication and cold-state strategies according to total cost rather than atom count alone.

## v0.50 — Sovereign and Inference-Safe Universe

### Security domains

Atoms and bonds are placed in explicit domains with authority, residency, jurisdiction, encryption and deduplication policies. Private domains may prohibit cross-object deduplication to avoid equality leakage.

### Purpose-bound closure authorization

Authorization evaluates the complete dependency and inference closure of a requested result. A user cannot combine separately visible facts to reconstruct a restricted compound unless their signed capability authorizes every required scope, predicate and purpose.

### Distributed physics authority

The generic physics cluster applies the v0.44 reaction system across replicas. Replicas independently simulate and sign the same proposal. A majority certificate authorizes commit. The cluster supports leader loss, election, history replay and failed-replica recovery.

The final audit completed 30 distributed commits, advanced to authority term 2, recovered convergence to one root and verified witness statements.

### Cryptographic erasure

Domain encryption keys are separable from ciphertext. An authorized destruction reaction removes the domain key, making retained ciphertext unrecoverable through the supplied system. This is qualified as bounded cryptographic erasure, not as a legal certification for every storage medium or backup environment.

## Metadata correction

The v0.42 package identified itself as `0.42.0.dev2`, while one internal audit JSON retained `0.42.0.dev1`. The v0.50 lineage includes a correction artifact and corrected audit copy. No test result or qualification metric changed.

## Scientific and engineering claim boundary

### Demonstrated in this package

- Universal exact recreation for the supported finite byte inputs inherited from v0.42.
- First-class recursive bond algebra and hyperbonds.
- Reaction-only official mutation path.
- Deterministic proof-carrying worldlines.
- Bounded neural-symbolic graph learning and OOD abstention.
- Application organs and identity federation.
- Temporal prediction, shadow worlds and incremental dependency updates.
- Governed embodiment contracts.
- Independently approved chemistry promotion and rollback.
- Purpose-bound inference closure, encryption and cryptographic erasure.
- Majority-certified distributed physics with failover and recovery.

### Not claimed complete

- Universal human-level semantic understanding of every open-world modality.
- Internet-scale or field-scale training quality.
- Formal theorem proving over every mathematical or domain logic.
- Production HSM/KMS custody and certified operational ceremonies.
- A compiled and independently audited Rust authority binary.
- Thirty elapsed wall-clock days or production SLA certification.

## Required external finalization

The remaining work is no longer undefined architecture. It is an external qualification program:

1. Build the Rust authority kernel with a pinned toolchain; run cross-language conformance, fuzzing, sanitizers, deterministic replay and independent security review.
2. Connect at least three real HSM/KMS authorities; test quorum signing, rotation, revocation, backup, disaster recovery and separation of duties.
3. Acquire licensed multimodal and field-sensor corpora; train and evaluate perception/dynamics organs against open-world, temporal, adversarial and safety suites.
4. Run the included real-time controller for at least 30 wall-clock days under representative load, chaos, restart, failover and SLA monitoring.
5. Obtain independent architecture, cryptographic, privacy and safety audits before any production deployment.
